title: Static modifiers
source: Both files are read by LoadModifierDefinitions (0x5A490) into CStaticModifier, whose keys are CModifier's: `icon` and the modifier names (see modifier_names). Loaded after common/ideologies.txt, so the suseptibility_<faction> names exist by then (FINDINGS-startup.md section 7). The 37 names LoadModifierDefinitions looks up are FINDINGS-leadership.md section 7; what each is for, FINDINGS-countrymodifier.md section 2 and FINDINGS-leadership.md section 8. Others are looked up by FindStaticModifierByName (0x123560).
